soldier: Major soldier: head reddish brown, mandibles dark brown, antennae and pronotum brownish yellow, mesonotum, metanotum and abdomen pale brownish yellow, legs yellowish white; about ten long setae on each side of the labrum, three to four on the postclypeus, the thoracic and abdominal tergites with only sparse hairs. Head nearly rectangular, widest at the middle, the posterior margin straight; mandibles stout, the apex incurved, the base of the left mandible with several incisions; labrum elliptical, the transparent apex triangular and pointed; fontanelle slightly in front of the middle, a small brown dot; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 1.5 to 2 times segment 2; postmentum long, contracted anteriorly, widest in front of the waist, parallel below it and narrowest at the anterior margin. Pronotum widest, the anterior and posterior margins distinctly incised; mesonotum narrowest with a broadly concave posterior margin; the posterior margin of the metanotum nearly flat; the anterolateral corners of the pronotum bluntly rounded, the lateral angles of the mesonotum and metanotum sharp. Minor soldier: head, labrum and antennae orange-yellow, mandibles reddish brown; eight to ten setae on each side of the labrum; head nearly rectangular with the posterior margin nearly flat; mandibles slender, elongate and rather straight; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 almost equal to segment 2; the anterolateral corners of the pronotum broadly lobed.
